parts.text: Regenerate the truth-reader implementation using the corrected configured design. Return response_type truth_reader_implementation and complete contents for every required repository file in files[]. Do not return patches. JSON files preserve the complete JSON value and associate distributed truth seeds structurally without losing source data. Keep enumerated doc selection, workflow-only CSPRNG seed authority, exact ordered evidence verification, FAIL as no-op, atomic PASS cleanup, immutable authoritative source documents, and recursion-safe GitHub workflow behavior.
